note: Score now uses /api/score (Pages Worker) instead of sinoky-score.kang7108558.workers.dev. Standalone Worker hung on mobile networks (vConsole showed [SCORE] → with no http response). Pages Worker doesn't support npm imports, so scoring uses a simplified algorithm (character overlap + length ratio) - sufficient for the short scene sentences. If phonetic-level feedback is needed later, pinyin-pro can be bundled with esbuild.
